vendorUiGzip.label: vendor-ui gzip budget
vendorUiGzip.rationale: The residual shared UI chunk is about 4.9 kB gzip after broad UI vendor grouping was removed; this cap keeps useful headroom while making regressions visible.

initialJsGzip.label: initial JS gzip budget
initialJsGzip.rationale: The authenticated shell baseline is about 163 kB gzip after splitting the Profiles route; this cap preserves headroom while catching accidental route code re-entry.

profilesPageGzip.label: ProfilesPage gzip budget
profilesPageGzip.rationale: Profiles is preloaded on direct route entry; its split route baseline is about 13.4 kB gzip and remains capped outside the initial shell budget.

objectsPageGzip.label: ObjectsPage gzip budget
objectsPageGzip.rationale: Objects is the heaviest task-completion surface; reusing the shared menu removes the route-local Ant Design menu runtime and leaves about 67.3 kB gzip in its route entry.

uploadsPageGzip.label: UploadsPage gzip budget
uploadsPageGzip.rationale: Uploads keeps one route-level lazy boundary around setup, bucket selection, source picking, and selection preview; its merged baseline is about 4.8 kB gzip.

transfersGzip.label: Transfers gzip budget
transfersGzip.rationale: Transfers carries realtime queue and job-event behavior, so the budget is looser than Uploads but still capped to catch accidental UI layering or duplicate runtime logic.
